note: Base capture fixtures for the 3 first-cut tours (contacts, dashboard, cadence-followup), curated from a LOCAL prod-shaped sweep (crm-admin --reset-and-seed --profile prod-shaped) against a CRM_ENV=testing localhost stack (native Postgres + go run ./cmd/crm-api, accelerated TIME_ACCELERATION=60). Staging was unreachable from the sweep host; the local reset is the source. Every capture is UUID-mapped + host-redacted by the tours normalizer, then run through judge/corpus/scrub.ts (email/phone -> <email:N>/<phone:N>).
